source: Authenticated native Groq console, read and operated through CUA after the user signed in.

projectLimits.action: Filled four Configure Model Limits fields, saved once, and read the resulting project table.

limitations: This records account/project ceilings; it does not reserve capacity from other organization usage.
It does not establish whether different models share a pool; only the existing20B model was enabled.
The runtime still has the older local guards at this capture; an independently verified code release must adopt the new limits.
No inference was used to verify these settings.
